div.div: 1 وَرَطَهَا He veiled, concealed, hid, or covered, her, or it, or them; [to what the pronoun relates is not said; but I incline to think that the right reading is وَرَّطَهَا, and that the pronoun relates to camels; (see 2;) as also ↓ اورطها : (L, TA:) from IAar. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
